title: Lessons from Recent Shooting Incidents in Amsterdam and Christchurch
what_it_is: Lessons from Recent Shooting Incidents in Amsterdam and Christchurch

sections.label: Utrecht and Christchurch attacks
sections.summary: The recent attacks in Utrecht and Christchurch are reminders of the threat from radicalism and terrorism.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The recent attacks in Utrecht and Christchurch are sombre reminders of the threat which radicalism and terrorism continue to pose.

sections.label: Rejecting extremist ideology
sections.summary: The first need is to unequivocally reject and counter extremist ideology and rhetoric.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: First is the need to unequivocally reject and counter extremist ideology and rhetoric.

sections.label: Singapore stance on extremism
sections.summary: Singapore takes a firm and unforgiving stance against extremist expressions and speech so their ideologies never take root.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: In Singapore, we take a firm and unforgiving stance against extremist expressions and speech to make sure that the ideologies they represent never take root.

sections.label: Firearms offences penalties
sections.summary: Unlawful possession of firearms is punishable with imprisonment and caning, and unlawful use is a capital offence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Today, unlawful possession of firearms is punishable with imprisonment and caning, and unlawful use is a capital offence.

sections.label: In-Situ Reaction Teams deployment
sections.summary: Police deployed In-Situ Reaction Teams at high human traffic areas, and more will be deployed island-wide this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Our Police have deployed In-Situ Reaction Teams (IRTs) at areas with high human traffic, such as Orchard Road and Marina Bay.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: More IRTs will be deployed island-wide this year, to further shorten our response time.

sections.label: SGSecure movement preparedness
sections.summary: The SGSecure movement launched in 2016 strengthened preparedness, with three in four Singaporeans knowing what to do at an attack scene.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The SGSecure movement launched in 2016 has greatly strengthened our preparedness as individuals and as a country to deal with a terror attack.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For instance, three in four Singaporeans responded that they know what to do if they are caught at the scene of an attack.
